verdict.rationale: PayPal documents an official MCP server that "lets merchants use natural language with their favorite MCP clients". A runtime probe shows the remote server at mcp.paypal.com is live behind OAuth. The documented agent tools cover orders, refunds, disputes, shipments and catalog, so merchants can run these operations through conversational commands. Missing for 10: a native first-party natural-language interface (it depends on third-party MCP clients/LLMs), and hands-on or independent corroboration that natural-language operation works end to end.
